Request a Consultation Memberships Financing Gift Cards Skincare Products Request a Consultation Request a Consultation Back Brianna Klein Spa Manager Locations: Dover Brianna has been a valued member of the Skin Health Medi Spa team since 2016, bringing over a decade of experience and dedication. Known for her calm demeanor and attention to detail, she ensures that every guest enjoys a relaxing, high-quality experience from the moment they walk through the door. Brianna obtained her Associate’s degree in Hospitality Management, with a focus in Spa Management, in 2015. With a background in spa operations, customer service, and a keen eye for marketing, Brianna also manages our social media presence, sharing updates, promotions, and fun behind-the-scenes glimpses of the spa with our online community. Outside of the spa, Brianna channels her creativity into her home bakery, BKsprinkles, where she whips up custom sweet treats for all kinds of occasions. Whether she’s crafting our next social media post, helping to manage the day, or baking up something sweet, Brianna brings passion and creativity to everything she does.
